description: OpenDCS is the community software used by U.S. water and weather agencies to collect and process hydrometeorological time series. It contains NOAA GOES satellite-feed decoding, other data-source connectors, near-real-time processing and database access through desktop applications and a REST API. Inputs are observation feeds and station configurations; outputs are decoded or processed time series and JSON database responses. Coverage and observation frequency depend on the connected stations and providers. Java source is free under Apache-2.0, with build and deployment instructions in the repository. A limitation is that version 8 requires Java 21 and some subsystems are undergoing major changes. The tool can prepare operational boundary conditions and observations for river, reservoir and flood simulations. T-Route (model-t-route) is a related river-routing model. No live station feed, database or desktop application was connected during this review.
name: OpenDCS hydrometeorological data collection
